Cell.Text: The Archmage! Hello, yes, I'm joined not long ago.
Hi! Yeah, I've joined not long ago.

Node.Caption: lope_AsterDialogues_meetAsterTopic: Hello, new College student I suppose?

Cell.Text: You can call me , and you are?
My name is Aster, good to meet you.
An apprentice, but yeah, I'm studying this school of magic. | And a bit of restoration as well. You know, if my conjuration goes wrong. *chuckle*

Node.Caption: lope_AsterDialogues_meetAsterA2: I see you are Conjuration mage?

Cell.Text: I like to summon atronachs and other creatures. Like to control them. | And making them do what I want. | Also I'd like to find the way to elongate their presence then summoned, make them stay here longer.

Sure, and longer it can have... well... do anything you want. | And of course more time to deeply study and better anknowledge summoned creature. | That's why I'd really love to learn more in this school of magic.

Node.Caption: lope_AsterDialogues_meetAsterA5: Longer atronach stay here longer it can fight on your side.

Cell.Text: Mainly lesser atronachs, like flame one. More often familiar, common and flaming one. | Few times did frost atronach. | Also weapons, like daggers and bows. Pretty cool feeling to have such weapon in hand. | But I wouldn't rely on such thing as it can vanish at the worst possible time.
Thanks, I'll keep trainings and researches to master summon skills.
Thank you. | It's really good to chat with someone. Sometimes I really need that. | Could we do it more often, please? You are such a great chatterer.
Mostly, reading and studying books about conjuration. | Other time I'm going to the Midden to summon something... or someone.

Node.Caption: lope_AsterDialogues_meetAsterA9: Sure, are you always at the Arcanaeum?

Cell.Text: [S] G|Sure, thanks. Bye for now then?

Node.Caption: lope_AsterDialogues_meetAsterA10: All right then, I'll see you next time.
